FAQ

What do you wear to a music festival?

Pick breathable layers like a tank or cami with a skirt, shorts or maxi dress, and comfortable shoes. Add a shawl or light layer for cooler evenings, and bring a small bag.

What shoes are best for a festival?

Wedge or buckle sandals with ankle straps are easier to wear all day than heels. Choose a pair you have already broken in, and bring blister protection if you will be walking a lot.
